card.name: Words just before 'discard' or 'throw out'
card.fires_on: The small word or verb right before an expected 'discarded', 'thrown out' or 'wasted', such as 'be' after 'unused portion should', or 'throw'. Seen in label directions on disposing of leftovers or priming sprays.

modes.label: Be before discarded
modes.description: The word 'be' after 'should' or 'must' when unused product is about to be discarded.
modes.example: any unused solution should<< be>> discarded.

modes.label: Throw out verbs
modes.description: The verb 'throw' or 'throwing' where leftover items are being thrown away.
modes.example: the patient should<< throw>> out the rest of the pack and start

modes.label: Sprays into the air
modes.description: The word 'into' after test sprays are released into the air to prime a device.
modes.example: releasing 4 test sprays<< into>> the air, away from the face,

card.writes: Promotes words for waste and discarding, such as 'waste', 'discard' and Chinese terms for garbage.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'discard' or 'throw away' in directions for getting rid of leftover product.
